answer: Each new agent must finish 60 paid jobs for distinct customers before its first copper reward unlocks, and each job carries a 2 POA fee that is burned. One identity pays 120 POA once; 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 POA, growing linearly, while an honest agent pays one time. A lantern auditor re-checks 10% of jobs and compares customer wallets; if two customers share a funder, the agent loses 80% of its stake. A fake's expected profit stays below zero at the horizon of 30 epochs.
